content:
iOS 27 added a large number of new features, covering areas such as Messages, Notes, Apple Wallet, CarPlay and more. Below are my three favorite new features in iOS 27 so far.

Number 1: Siri App

Siri in iOS 27 has been completely revamped, rebuilt from scratch for the AI era. One exciting upgrade is the standalone Siri app. According to Apple's press release:

The Siri app provides you with a convenient and quick centralized starting point for handling various questions. It is especially suitable for conducting chatbot-style conversations that go beyond simple requests.

Given the popularity of apps like ChatGPT, Claude and Google Gemini, launching a standalone Siri app is indeed quite reasonable. And since it comes pre-installed on the iPhone home screen, I expect it will quickly become an app that many users use frequently.

Number 2: One-Tap Suggestions in Messages

iOS 27 has plenty of Apple Intelligence features that don't feel like "AI" but simply provide practical tools. Actionable suggestions in the Messages app are an excellent example. Apple states:

Many messaging apps have tried to incorporate AI chatbots into conversations, but I never really liked this approach.

However, the one-tap suggestions in Messages are equally practical in many ways, and are faster and easier to use than typing an AI request. This is exactly the kind of AI feature I fully support.

Number 3: "Smart Event Details" in Apple Calendar

iOS 27 adds a new feature I've been looking forward to in Apple Calendar: creating events using natural language. Apple calls it "Smart Event Details".

With the help of Apple Intelligence, you can type an event in your own words, and iOS 27 will automatically detect and fill in important details, including:

  • Title
  • Time
  • Location
  • Invitees

With Smart Event Details, you no longer need to manually enter these details one by one. Just write everything in one line of text, and the AI will update the event accordingly.

Which iOS 27 feature is your favorite so far? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
